title: NCLT Bengaluru Admits Nadella Agrotech Into CIRP Over Unpaid Palm Olein Dues to US Supplier
case_name: In re Nadella Agrotech Private Limited (on the petition of Voyager Trading Partners LLC)
card_summary: NCLT Bengaluru admitted Nadella Agrotech into insolvency on a petition by US-based Voyager Trading Partners over unpaid palm olein invoices. Nadella argued the sale agreement was unstamped and unsigned by anyone with shown authority, and that assigning the receivables to a financier made the claim a financial debt outside an operational creditor's standing. Both defences failed and the company was admitted into CIRP.
card_tip: Assigning export receivables to a trade financier for discounting does not convert the underlying sale debt into financial debt; an operational creditor's standing to seek CIRP survives such an arrangement.
verification_notes: Confirmed by two independent reports (LiveLawBiz, SupremeToday) agreeing on parties, forum, date and defences raised; exact claim amount was unclear between sources and is omitted. Order itself not accessed.
